channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Messi’s Kolkata Stadium Visit Turns Chaotic as Fans Clash with Officials over Limited Access
item.description: Thousands of fans who paid premium prices were left angry after poor planning, VIP crowding and Messi’s short stadium appearance triggered unrest in Kolkata.

item.title: Union Cabinet Approves ₹11,718 Crore for India’s First Digital 2027 Census with Caste Enumeration, No NPR
item.description: The Union Cabinet has greenlit ₹11,718.24 crore for a fully digital Census 2027, featuring India's first post-independence caste count and advanced tech, sans separate NPR funding.

item.title: Australia’s Bondi Beach Shooting: 12 Killed in Attack on Jewish Community Event
item.description: A deadly shooting at Australia’s Bondi Beach during a Jewish Hanukkah celebration left 12 people dead, triggering shock, grief, and urgent questions about public safety and communal harmony.

item.title: India Rejects Bangladesh’s Sheikh Hasina Terror Claims After Envoy Summoned Over Election Threats
item.description: New Delhi firmly denies allowing exiled Sheikh Hasina to incite terrorism from Indian soil, following Dhaka's envoy summons and extradition push amid rising bilateral strains.

item.title: Bondi Beach Terror Attack: At Least 15 Dead, Several Injured in Australia; Father-Son Suspects Identified
item.description: Father and son duo identified as alleged gunmen using licensed firearms in the deadly Bondi Beach terror attack.

item.title: President Murmu Rejects Mercy Plea of Man Convict in Maharashtra Two-Year-Old’s Rape and Murder Case
item.description: President Droupadi Murmu's rejection of Ravi Ashok Ghumare's mercy plea upholds the death sentence for the brutal 2012 kidnapping, rape, and murder of a two-year-old girl in Maharashtra's Jalna district.

item.title: Pune Cancer Fighter’s Hunger Strike Exposes SLB’s Shocking ₹2.5-3 Cr Firing Amid Treatment
item.description: Santosh Patole's indefinite fast outside SLB's Pune office demands justice after his abrupt dismissal halted cancer care coverage.

item.title: Dense Fog Disrupts Delhi Airport Operations as Near-Zero Visibility Triggers Flight Cancellations, Diversions
item.description: Severe fog and 'Severe Plus' smog crippled Delhi, cancelling 40 flights and breaching the 450 AQI mark.

item.title: Behind JK of The Family Man: How Sharib Hashmi and Cancer-Survivor Wife Nasreen’s 30-Year Love Story Inspires 2025 Buzz
item.description: Amid financial hardships and four oral cancer battles, Nasreen Hashmi stood as the unbreakable pillar behind actor Sharib Hashmi's journey from job quitter to The Family Man star.

item.title: Haryana Man Allegedly Kills Girlfriend Over Marriage Pressure, Chops Off Head to Hide Identity; Arrested
item.description: Man arrested in Haryana for allegedly killing former lover in a twisted affair. Read here in detail.
